title: BetterBench: Assessing AI Benchmarks, Uncovering Issues, and Establishing Best Practices
reasoning: The paper focuses on establishing a meta-evaluation framework to assess the quality, usability, and documentation of AI benchmarks. While it includes benchmarks for ethical behavior (e.g., Machiavelli) in its assessment set, its primary purpose is evaluating the methodologies of benchmark construction rather than specifically evaluating religion, morals, or ethics.
